quoted_tweet.text:
8 days into the @RoboNetHQ × @Lighter_xyz competition. 

Here's what I'm watching.

The scoring metric is Trading Efficiency: Net PnL ÷ Total Volume. Not raw profit.This is actually a brutal filter. Here's why:

A strategy that made $2,000 on $100,000 volume scores worse than one that made $500 on $5,000 volume. The competition specifically rewards strategies that extract alpha without overtrading.

In an $80K BTC environment with stablecoin reserves dropping and liquidity thinning that distinction matters even more. Overtrading in a low-liquidity market doesn't just reduce efficiency scores. It increases slippage and eats into real PnL.

The strategies likely leading right now aren't the most aggressive ones. They're the ones with the tightest signal-to-trade ratio and only executing when the edge is clear.

This is what @AlloraNetwork's 8-hour inference window is designed for. 

Not noise filtering every tick. A deliberate time horizon that forces the strategy to wait for conviction before acting.

Fewer trades. Higher quality. Better efficiency score.
The real test starts now when early leaders have to decide whether to hold their strategy or chase the leaderboard.

1) @xStocksFi went live on Mantle, enabled by @flowdesk_co with top tokenized equities available for 24/7 trading via @Fluxion_network.

4) @0xMantleCN co-hosted with @byreal_io, @OpenBuildxyz and @ChainforGood to gather the most cracked builders in Hangzhou.

5) The Turing Test Hackathon kicked off with $120K across two phases, co-hosted with @Bybit_Official, @ChainforGood, @byreal_io, and co-supported by @DoraHacks and @HackQuest_.

6) Phase 1, ClawHack, ended with 500 whitelist slots and 1,000+ RealClaw agents deployed on Mantle, powered by @byreal_io.

8) Mantle's Satoshi Easter campaign concluded with over 1,000 participants.

9) @Infinit_Labs's Prompt-to-DeFi launched new agents on Mantle for swapping, lending, borrowing and more.

10) @StarchildOnX agents can trade, deploy contracts, and manage DeFi positions on Mantle.

11) @QuackAI_AI's Q402 expanded to Mantle, bringing gasless stablecoin settlement with zero gas barriers.

12) Fluxion integrated @elfa_ai for real-time social alphas and trade setups on Mantle.

13) @Accredify_io integrated with Mantle to issue Verifiable Credentials, enterprise and government-grade trusted for RWAs with native ZKP support.

14) @0xStableFlow went live on Mantle for frictionless stablecoin movement from any chain with zero slippage.

15) @pieverse_io brought Mantle AI Agent Skills & Scaffold into the Purr-Fect Claw.

16) @OpenGradient went live on the distribution layer with onchain trading and liquidity provision via @Fluxion_network + Season 2 coming up.

17) @printr v2 went live on Mantle.

18) @Alpha_Bybit launched the USD1 trading arena on Mantle for traders to earn from the @worldlibertyfi prize pool.

19) Mantle gathered builders, researchers, investors and ecosystem partners in Hong Kong with @tencentcloud, @worldbuildlabs, @StarchildOnX and @caladanxyz.

20) Mantle kicked off the North America World Tour at @CUBlockchain and @CalBlockchain.

21) Mantle's heading to @consensus2026 alongside @solana Accelerate, @MetaMask Builder Nights, and more.

Other Ecosystem Updates:

22) @AlloraNetwork launched an autonomous Agentic Vault using Allora inference signals with @RoboNetHQ and @paradex.

23) INFINIT's Prompt-to-DeFi Strategist Leaderboard went live.

24) @redstone_defi launched RedStone Settle for instant RWA liquidation, removing the 60-180 day redemption window entirely.

25) StableFlow now supports frxUSD by @fraxfinance.

26) @SuccinctLabs launched ZCAM, an iPhone camera app that cryptographically signs photos and videos at capture for instant real vs AI verification.

27) @USDT0_to powered @Tether's new @tetherwallet rollout, putting dollars and gold onchain with second-level settlement for cents.

28) @virtuals_io scaled agentic commerce to $4M+ in revenue settlements, 18K+ agents transacting autonomously, and 116K wallets participating in the agentic economy.

29) @nansen_ai enabled pay-per-call onchain data access with x402 and PayAI for institutional-grade analytics.

30) @LayerZero_Core crossed $250B in Total Value Transferred.

April said its piece, and you can clearly tell what we mean when we say MoMNTum's inevitable.

Happy Labour Day. The fruits of ours are above.

Onwards, May.
